Each business is given a ‘hygiene rating’ when it is inspected by a food safety officer from the business’s local authority.  The food hygiene rating will help you to make an informed choice by  giving information about how closely a business is meeting the requirements of food hygiene law.
Assists local authorities in monitoring care home performance in their area.
